metadata.description: Language Server Protocol tooling for coding agents — vendor-neutral CLI/MCP bridge plus Claude Code LSP plugins

plugins.name: ty-lsp
plugins.description: Registers ty (Astral) as Claude Code's Python language server: definitions, references, hover, call hierarchy. Requires `ty` on PATH (`uv tool install ty`). Python only -- Claude's built-in LSP tool answers incompletely on unregistered languages, so use RossLabs LSP for anything else.
